# BR-500 pH and DO Control: Control Narrative (Module BR500-PHDO)

Draft for review. Revision A, 2026-10-19.

**Basis and assumptions**
- BR-500 is a batch process. States and phases follow ISA-88, not ISA-106. ISA-106 covers continuous processes.
- You gave no instrument index, cause-and-effect chart, or alarm database. This document lists the tags, interlocks and alarms the module needs.
- Values marked "confirm" in the setpoint list are my proposals. They are not design basis until Process approves them.
- No SIS function is specified here. See OI-03.
- **Test column:** SIM = force or simulate an input. CHL = challenge on the equipment (water run). INS = inspect configuration or document. REC = review the audit trail or batch record.

## 1. Purpose and boundaries

BR500-PHDO controls pH and dissolved oxygen (DO) in the 2000 L single-use bioreactor BR-500. The module is active from Equilibrate through Production.

| Interface | Direction | Content |
|---|---|---|
| Batch phase manager | In | Phase commands (start, hold, restart, stop, abort), batch ID, recipe setpoints |
| Batch phase manager | Out | Module state, base volume used |
| Gas supply (CO2, air, O2) | Out | Flow commands to FCV-510, FCV-511, FCV-512 |
| Base bag and pump | Out | Run command to P-520 |
| Agitator drive | Out | Speed setpoint to SIC-530 |

The module does not control temperature, vessel pressure, feed, foam, or agitation outside its active phases.

## 4. States and transitions

The module follows the ISA-88 phase state model, reduced to the states below. Operations must sign off on this table (OI-09).

**Batch phase to module state**

| Batch phase | Module state |
|---|---|
| Media Fill | Idle |
| Equilibrate | Idle → Running (SQ-1 at phase start) |
| Inoculate | Running (no output step at transition) |
| Production | Running (no output step at transition) |
| Harvest | Running → Stopping → Complete (SQ-4) |

**State table**

| FR ID | State | Entry condition | Outputs | Exits | Initiator | Automation level | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-100 | Idle | Power-up of a new batch, or reset from Complete or Aborted | FCV-510, FCV-511, FCV-512 closed. P-520 off. SIC-530 not commanded. | Running | Operator starts Equilibrate | Operator-prompted, then automatic | SIM |
| FR-BR500-101 | Running | SQ-1 complete | Loops active in Auto or Manual | Holding, Stopping, Aborting | Auto or operator | Automatic | SIM |
| FR-BR500-102 | Holding | Operator hold, SQ-1 or Restarting failure, or controller restart | FCV-510 closed. P-520 off. FCV-512 closed. FCV-511 and SIC-530 hold last value. | Held within SP-066 | Operator or auto | Automatic | SIM |
| FR-BR500-103 | Held | Holding complete | Same as Holding. Operator may set outputs manually (FR-BR500-104). | Restarting, Stopping, Aborting | Operator | Manual | SIM |
| FR-BR500-104 | Held, manual outputs | Operator sets an output in Held | Limits and interlocks of section 8 still apply | n/a | Operator | Manual | SIM |
| FR-BR500-105 | Restarting | Operator restart and SQ-1 permissives met | Loops initialize bumpless to current outputs | Running, or Held after SP-067 | Operator | Operator-prompted | SIM |
| FR-BR500-106 | Stopping | Harvest starts, or Production ends | SQ-4 | Complete | Auto | Automatic | SIM |
| FR-BR500-107 | Complete | SQ-4 done | Same as Idle | Idle | Batch manager | Automatic | SIM |
| FR-BR500-108 | Aborting | Operator abort or batch abort | FCV-510, FCV-511, FCV-512 closed. P-520 off. SIC-530 released. | Aborted | Operator | Automatic | SIM |
| FR-BR500-109 | Aborted | Aborting done | Same as Idle | Idle after operator reset | Operator | Manual | SIM |

## 5. Regulatory control

No tuning values appear here. Tuning belongs in the software design specification and the commissioning record.

### 5.1 pH loop

| FR ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-200 | When AT-501A and AT-501B are both healthy, the pH PV is their average. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-201 | When one probe is not healthy, the PV is the value of the healthy probe. The module raises AL-501A or AL-501B. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-202 | When neither probe is healthy, FR-BR500-503 applies. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-203 | The operator can select AT-501A, AT-501B, or Average as PV source. If the selected probe is not healthy, the module uses the other probe and raises the alarm. The selection is recorded. | SIM, REC |
| FR-BR500-204 | When PV is above SP-001 plus SP-002, FCV-510 opens in proportion to the PID output within SP-010. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-205 | When PV is below SP-001 minus SP-002, P-520 runs in proportion to the PID output. Output is limited to SP-024. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-206 | When PV is within SP-002 of SP-001, FCV-510 is at zero and P-520 is off. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-207 | FCV-510 and P-520 never run at the same time. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-208 | The PID integral term must not wind up inside the deadband. Auto-Manual changes must not step the outputs. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-209 | In Manual, the operator sets FCV-510 flow or P-520 speed. Interlocks of section 8 still apply. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-210 | Base volume used equals mass lost from WT-521 divided by SP-023. | CHL |
| FR-BR500-211 | The base volume used survives controller restart and base bag change. A new batch ID resets it to zero. | SIM, REC |
| FR-BR500-212 | When base volume used reaches SP-022, the module raises AL-506. Control continues. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-213 | When base volume used reaches SP-021, FR-BR500-501 applies. | SIM |

### 5.2 DO loop

One PID output (0 to 100 %) drives three stages in sequence. The same map applies for rising and falling demand.

| FR ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-300 | The DO PV is the average of AT-502A and AT-502B when both are healthy. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-301 | When one probe is not healthy, the PV is the healthy probe. The module raises AL-502A or AL-502B. The operator can select the source as in FR-BR500-203. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-302 | When neither probe is healthy, FR-BR500-504 applies. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-303 | Stage 1, output in the SP-030 band: SIC-530 setpoint moves linearly from SP-013 to SP-014. FCV-511 and FCV-512 are closed. | SIM, CHL |
| FR-BR500-304 | Stage 2, output in the SP-031 band: SIC-530 stays at SP-014. FCV-511 moves linearly from closed to SP-011 maximum. FCV-512 is closed. | SIM, CHL |
| FR-BR500-305 | Stage 3, output in the SP-032 band: SIC-530 stays at SP-014. FCV-511 stays at SP-011 maximum. FCV-512 moves linearly from closed to SP-012 maximum. | SIM, CHL |
| FR-BR500-306 | SIC-530 setpoint from this module is never below SP-013 or above SP-014. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-307 | In Manual, the operator sets the 0 to 100 % demand. The stage map still applies. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-308 | When all stages are at maximum and DO stays below setpoint for SP-057, the module raises AL-530. | SIM |

## 6. Sequences

### SQ-1 Module start (Idle → Running, or Restarting)

| FR ID | Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-401 | 1 | Check permissives: at least one healthy pH probe and one healthy DO probe; WT-521 healthy; base used below SP-021; SIC-530 healthy; minimum volume permissive met (OI-02). | All true | SP-062 | Go to Holding. Show PR-06 with the failed items. |
| FR-BR500-402 | 2 | On first start only: load SP-001, SP-002, SP-003 from the recipe. Restart keeps current setpoints. | Values loaded and in entry limits | SP-062 | Go to Holding. Raise alarm. |
| FR-BR500-403 | 3 | Set SIC-530 to SP-013 on first start. Initialize PID outputs to current output values. Set loops to Auto. | Loops report Auto | SP-062 | Go to Holding. |
| FR-BR500-404 | 4 | Report Running to the batch manager. | Running reported | SP-062 | Go to Holding. |

### SQ-2 Setpoint change in Production

| FR ID | Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-420 | 1 | Operator enters a new value for a parameter marked "Rec" in section 3. | Value is inside entry limits (SP-040, SP-041, SP-042) | n/a | Reject the value. Keep the old value. |
| FR-BR500-421 | 2 | Show PR-02. Operator enters a reason. | Reason is not empty | SP-063 | Discard the change. Keep the old value. |
| FR-BR500-422 | 3 | Apply the new value. | Value active in the controller | 5 s (confirm) | Keep the old value. Raise alarm. |
| FR-BR500-423 | 4 | Write the record to the batch event journal and audit trail: parameter, old value, new value, user, time, reason, batch ID. | Record stored | 5 s (confirm) | Reverse the change. Raise alarm. |

Outside Production, a change is recorded in the audit trail without a reason prompt. OI-06 covers electronic signature.

### SQ-3 Base bag change

| FR ID | Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-430 | 1 | Operator requests bag change. Stop P-520 and block base dosing. | P-520 off | 5 s | Alarm. Do not continue. |
| FR-BR500-431 | 2 | Show PR-03. Operator replaces the bag and pushes CONFIRM. | CONFIRM pushed and WT-521 healthy | SP-064 | Keep P-520 blocked. Raise AL-509. |
| FR-BR500-432 | 3 | Read the new WT-521 mass as the new baseline. Keep the base volume used unchanged. | WT-521 stable for SP-060 | SP-064 | Keep P-520 blocked. Raise AL-509. |
| FR-BR500-433 | 4 | Release the block on P-520. | Block released | 5 s | Alarm. |

### SQ-4 Module stop (Harvest)

| FR ID | Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-440 | 1 | Close FCV-510, FCV-511, FCV-512. Stop P-520. | All commands at safe state | SP-065 | Force outputs to safe state. Raise alarm. |
| FR-BR500-441 | 2 | Release SIC-530 to the Harvest phase. | Phase accepts the setpoint | SP-065 | Hold SIC-530 at last speed. Raise alarm. |
| FR-BR500-442 | 3 | Report Complete. | Reported | SP-065 | Raise alarm. |

## 7. Interlocks and permissives

No cause-and-effect chart was supplied, so the rows are written here.

| FR ID | Cause | Effect | Latched or auto-reset | Reset method | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-501 | Base volume used at or above SP-021 | P-520 off. Base blocked in Auto and Manual. AL-507. | Latched | New batch ID only. No in-batch reset. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-502 | WT-521 not healthy | P-520 off. Base blocked. | Latched | Operator acknowledges after WT-521 is healthy for SP-060. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-503 | Both pH probes not healthy | FCV-510 closed. P-520 off. | Auto-reset | Auto, when one probe is healthy for SP-060 | SIM |
| FR-BR500-504 | Both DO probes not healthy | FCV-512 closed. SIC-530 and FCV-511 hold last value. | Auto-reset | Auto, when one probe is healthy for SP-060 | SIM |
| FR-BR500-505 | Module state is not Running (except Held manual per FR-BR500-104) | FCV-510 and P-520 off | Auto-reset | State returns to Running | SIM |
| FR-BR500-506 | Batch phase is not Equilibrate, Inoculate, or Production | All module outputs at safe state (FR-BR500-100) | Auto-reset | Phase change | SIM |
| FR-BR500-507 | SIC-530 faulted, stopped, or comms lost | FCV-512 closed. AL-531. | Auto-reset | Auto, when SIC-530 is healthy for SP-060 | SIM |
| FR-BR500-508 | Base bag change in progress (SQ-3) | P-520 off | Auto-reset | SQ-3 step 4 | SIM |
| FR-BR500-509 | Comms loss to P-520 drive for SP-061 | P-520 stops (drive watchdog). AL-540. | Auto-reset | Comms restored | SIM |
| FR-BR500-510 | Minimum volume permissive lost (OI-02) | FCV-510, FCV-511, FCV-512 closed. P-520 off. | Auto-reset | Permissive restored | SIM |

| FR-BR500-610 | AL-520 | DO differs from SP-003 by more than SP-052 for SP-053 | Medium | Check gas supply and agitator. Compare with an off-line sample. | SIM |

| FR-BR500-612 | AL-505 | DO probes differ by more than SP-055 for SP-056 | Medium | Compare with an off-line sample. Select the correct probe (PR-01). | SIM |

| FR-BR500-614 | AL-530 | Cascade saturated (FR-BR500-308) | Medium | Tell the supervisor. Check the cell density and gas supply. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-615 | AL-531 | SIC-530 faulted or comms lost | High | Check the agitator drive. O2 sparge is closed. | SIM |

## 9. Abnormal handling

| FR ID | Event | Detection | Response | Recovery | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-701 | Bad PV (any probe or WT-521) | Signal out of range, transmitter fault, comms loss for SP-061, or probe in calibration mode, for SP-060 | The input is not healthy. See FR-BR500-201, 301, 502, 503, 504. | Healthy for SP-060 | SIM |
| FR-BR500-702 | Comms loss, transmitter or I/O | As bad PV | As bad PV | Comms restored | SIM |
| FR-BR500-703 | Comms loss, P-520 drive | Watchdog | FR-BR500-509 | Comms restored | SIM |
| FR-BR500-704 | Comms loss, SIC-530 | Watchdog | FR-BR500-507. SIC-530 holds last speed. | Comms restored | SIM |
| FR-BR500-705 | Controller power loss and restart | Controller restart | Valves at fail position, P-520 off. On restart, module goes to Held, raises AL-542, and shows PR-04. No automatic restart. | Operator pushes RESTART. SQ-1 runs. | SIM |
| FR-BR500-706 | Retained data on restart | n/a | The module keeps these across restart: setpoints, modes, probe selection, base volume used, state before restart. | n/a | SIM, INS |
| FR-BR500-707 | Field power or gas supply loss | Valve feedback or flow deviation | Valves go to the fail position in section 2. P-520 stops. | Power or supply restored, then operator restart | CHL |

## 12. OQ derivation

Derive one or more OQ test cases from each FR ID. The pass criterion is the FR statement. The Test column gives the method. Key test groups:
- Probe selection and failure: FR-BR500-200 to 203, 300 to 302, 701
- Deadband and split of acid and base: FR-BR500-204 to 208
- Base accounting and limit: FR-BR500-210 to 213, 501, 502, 608, 609
- DO cascade order and limits: FR-BR500-303 to 308
- State and phase mapping: FR-BR500-100 to 109
- Setpoint change record: FR-BR500-420 to 423
- Power loss and restart: FR-BR500-705, 706
